name: Everline Resort & Spa
insider_take: Nestled on the shores of pristine Lake Tahoe at 6,200 feet elevation, this former Olympic Village turned luxury resort offers year-round alpine adventures with breathtaking panoramic lake and mountain views.
whats_special: Built for the 1960 Winter Olympics, Everline sits on 400 acres of protected wilderness at the base of Olympic Valley. The resort features the only lakefront golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. at Lake Tahoe, plus direct access to world-class skiing at Palisades Tahoe (formerly Squaw Valley). The crystal-clear waters of Lake Tahoe are so pure you can drink directly from the lake.
pro_tip: Book a lakefront room during autumn for spectacular fall foliage reflections on the water, or visit in winter when the lake rarely freezes due to its incredible 1,645-foot depth.
dont_miss: Take the aerial tramway up to High Camp for 360-degree views of Lake Tahoe and the Sierra Nevada mountains. Visit nearby Emerald Bay State Park, one of the most photographed spots in the world, and explore the historic Vikingsholm Castle. The resort's spa treatments using locally-sourced sage and lavender are exceptional after a day on the slopes or lake.
pros: Stunning Lake Tahoe mountain setting with pristine natural surroundings
Full-service spa and wellness facilities for complete relaxation
Championship golf course with scenic alpine views
Year-round outdoor recreation including skiing and hiking access
cons: Remote mountain location requires travel planning
Seasonal weather variations may limit some activities
